PROG.name: Software Development
PROG.description: Designing, building, refactoring, and verifying software components, algorithms, and systems.

TEST.name: Testing
TEST.description: Constructing test suites, automated test execution, QA verification, regression analysis, and assertion contracts.

REQM.name: Requirements Definition and Management
REQM.description: Defining user stories, specifications, architectural design documents, acceptance criteria, and system constraints.

DBDS.name: Database Design
DBDS.description: Data modeling, schema migrations, table relationships, indexing, query optimization, and storage engines.

VISU.name: Visual Design
VISU.description: User interface design, CSS layouts, styling, components, responsive templates, and design systems.

ANIM.name: Animation Development
ANIM.description: 2D/3D skeletal animation, keyframe curves, transition effects, particle dynamics, and motion scripting.

GRAP.name: Graphic Design
GRAP.description: Vector illustration, SVG assets, iconography, typography, infographics, and promotional imagery.

MUDI.name: Multimedia Design
MUDI.description: Video production, montage editing, audio-visual sync, streaming pipelines, and rich media assets.

SNDD.name: Sound Design & Audio Scripting
SNDD.description: Audio composition, Foley sound effects, synthetic waveforms, voice synthesis, and audio DSP scripting.

ICDV.name: Interactive & VR/AR Development
ICDV.description: Spatial computing, WebXR, stereoscopic scenes, 3D world interaction, and haptic / immersive engines.

BUSA.name: Business Analysis
BUSA.description: Evaluating business processes, operational metrics, stakeholder workflows, and feasibility economics.

MKTG.name: Marketing & Positioning
MKTG.description: Go-to-market strategy, product positioning, launch announcements, press releases, and developer outreach.

COMM.name: Communications & Technical Writing
COMM.description: Documentation, user guides, runbooks, release notes, tutorials, and technical retrospectives.

PROD.name: Product Management
PROD.description: Roadmap planning, sprint backlog grooming, KPI setting, feature prioritization, and launch milestones.

UNAN.name: Unclassified / General Operations
UNAN.description: Unclassified, ad-hoc, or cross-cutting operational tasks.
